For the Informant : M/s. Abhishek Kumar, Advocate
-----
06/06.02.2025 Heard the parties

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Madhupur P.S. Case No. 0198/2023,
for the offences registered under Section 376(2)(n) of the I.P.C., 1860, pending in the Court of
learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Madhupur.
3.  On the pretext of marriage, the petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the informant who is aged about 28 years.
Later on, he refused to marry her.
4. It appears that the parties were in consensual physical relationship for the last ten years.
5. Mr. Abhishek Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
